title: TinyLM — Local LLM Inference Microservice
description: High-performance local LLM inference microservice optimized for constrained memory (RAM ≤ 2 GB). Exposes a FastAPI REST API executing Qwen2.5-1.5B GGUF via llama-cpp-python on Alpine Linux containers with a multi-stage security design.
highlights: Multi-stage Docker architecture on Alpine Linux with container hardening to minimize attack surface.
Optimized OpenAI-compatible REST inference endpoints (/v1/chat/completions) and health probes (/health).
Strict heap memory control, lazy loading strategies, and idempotent model deployment.

title: Unity 2D Multiplayer .NET Backend Architecture
description: Enterprise C# and .NET 9 backend boilerplate with SignalR and WebSockets for 2D multiplayer games and virtual environments in Unity. Handles presence, movement, and spatial rooms with low latency.
highlights: Real-time WebSocket/SignalR synchronization supporting client grouping in spatial rooms.
Layered Clean Architecture, EF Core, Redis Backplane, and full Docker containerization.
Secure coding practices integration and cross-platform automation for .NET Standard 2.1 clients.

title: RESTful Task API (Clean Arch & Security Hardened)
description: Containerized RESTful Task API built with FastAPI and Python 3.12. Structured under Clean Architecture and Domain-Driven Design (DDD) with protection against common security vulnerabilities.
highlights: Decoupled Clean Architecture layers (Domain, Application, Infrastructure, API Presentation).
Relational database modeling with SQLModel (SQLAlchemy + Pydantic) and OWASP SQL injection mitigation.
Automated unit and integration testing suite with pytest and reproducible Docker Compose orchestration.

title: Sorting Algorithms & Memory Benchmarks (.NET 10)
description: High-performance modular C# (.NET 10) library for fundamental sorting algorithms and data structures. Built with Clean Architecture, BenchmarkDotNet memory profiling, and xUnit test suites.
highlights: Decoupled generic implementations of QuickSort, MergeSort, HeapSort, InsertionSort, TimSort, and BubbleSort.
CPU timing and microsecond heap memory allocation profiling via BenchmarkDotNet.
Parameterized unit test suite with xUnit and expressive assertions using FluentAssertions.

title: Low-Latency WebSocket Server Engine
description: Real-time, high-concurrency bidirectional WebSocket engine written in C# and .NET Core, optimized for continuous event streaming, low latency, and high stability.
highlights: High-performance asynchronous management of concurrent connections and socket lifecycle.
Lightweight messaging protocol to minimize CPU overhead and network bandwidth consumption.
Modular architecture ready for integration as a secure backend service in distributed systems.
